source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Verify AMD Platform BIOS Settings defaults and persistence of approved non-default controls without unexpectedly changing platform routing, PCIe/storage/graphics visibility, boot behavior, power/thermal policy or management reachability.
original_method: Manually load BIOS defaults, compare named PBS fields with the platform SPEC, apply a bounded per-field matrix, save and use the documented reset, verify persistence and correlate each field with exact platform/device/boot/power effects.
manual_activity: An engineer must interpret, operate and visually accept vendor-specific AMD PBS controls. Automated platform inventories and telemetry are supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Board/BIOS/AGESA/BMC/CPU identity and exact PBS page revision
Named field definitions and dependencies on PCIe, storage, graphics, clocks, power, thermal, boot and routing
SPEC defaults and approved bounded values
Critical-device persistent identities and expected per-field deltas
Required warm/cold reset, stable power and independent console/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or extrapolate a PBS field meaning from another AMD platform or AGESA release.
Require field-level vendor/platform documentation because identical labels may have board-specific wiring and dependencies.
Protect boot storage, management NIC, GPU/display, critical PCIe devices and thermal/power limits.
Capture persistent identities and baseline telemetry before changes; do not rely on enumeration order.
Stop on missing/remapped device, boot failure, thermal/power excursion, RAS error or management loss.
Restore the approved final state; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only CPU/memory/PCIe/storage/graphics topology, persistent device IDs, boot state, clocks/power/thermal/RAS telemetry, logs and BMC health.
Compare only owner-approved expected deltas around operator phases.
Do not drive BIOS, infer undocumented semantics, change device or power policy, stress hardware or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact platform-specific field definitions, values, dependencies, reset and recovery.
Perform and capture default-first and bounded non-default firmware phases.
Interpret device/boot/power/thermal evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; OS device or power settings are not equivalent to PBS firmware policy.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the firmware method and add platform/version-specific, read-only topology, boot, power/thermal and RAS evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The default-first lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random remains source text only.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For each documented PBS field, record board/AGESA applicability, affected devices/routes/clocks/power states, required reset and exact expected evidence; execute one bounded change at a time with OOB recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the exact board, CPU generation, BIOS/AGESA and hardware population documented by the owner.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, AGESA, BMC, device firmware, OS/kernel/driver and telemetry-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform vendor AMD PBS field documentation and approved board/AGESA release notes.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random changes with per-field platform semantics and causal evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves defaults/persistence and adds dependency, device, power/thermal and RAS coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field dictionary, dependencies, values, reset, limits and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Public AMD documentation may not define OEM PBS wiring; undocumented fields must remain untested pending vendor guidance.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a subset of PBS fields for its exact board population. Results must name tested fields, dependencies and omissions and cannot be generalized to other platforms or AGESA versions.
expected_evidence: Exact platform/AGESA identity, PBS field/default/dependency matrix, limits and recovery
Baseline persistent device topology, boot, power/thermal/RAS and management health
Load Default captures plus SPEC and platform comparison
Per-field non-default captures, persistence and causal expected deltas
Approved final state, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The default-first and persistence lifecycle agrees with the criteria. Vendor-specific field definitions are project/platform readiness inputs, not contradictory source facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The PBS configuration lifecycle is clear. Missing platform documentation gates execution but does not make the reusable master case permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual firmware operation and adds field-specific platform/AGESA dependency safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its platform/device/power evidence while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates firmware acceptance from supporting telemetry and prevents cross-platform semantic assumptions.

review_improvement: Makes every vendor-specific PBS change causally traceable to exact devices and platform behavior rather than accepting persistence alone.
independent_technical_reasoning: The core operation and acceptance are interactive, platform-specific firmware work. Automated telemetry cannot interpret or complete those BIOS actions, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat PBS changes, resets or recovery after device, boot, power, thermal, RAS or management anomalies; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
